findings: l.1834 (proof of lem:embedding_tame): 'The morphism M -> N lifts to a morphism \widetilde M -> \widetilde N' fails when f sends regular points to singular ones: for the k-fold quotient R^2 -> E^2_{2pi/k} (an a.e. morphism, regular off 0), a lift R^2 -> \widetilde N over f would restrict to a lift of R^2\{0} -> cone\{apex} to its universal cover, impossible since the generator of pi_1 maps to k times a generator (sketch, not formalized). The statement is true: the Lean proof lifts from \widehat M = \widetilde M^{M\U}, U portly with f regular on U, into \widetilde{reg N}, extends the lift to the Fox completions (IsFoxCompletion.existsUnique_extend), composes with the developing map of \widetilde N (lem:morphism_singular_manifolds_branched) and concludes by prop:branched_devmap.
